plan.scope: All nodal mobility under frozen equivalent loads with distributed real inertia; aerodynamic feedback and apparent mass excluded.
limits: Complex spectral shifts are evaluation points, not added material damping.
Native modes seed local independent pole brackets; no complete continuum spectrum classification.
Worst individual nodal-column differences are reported, not bounded by the whole-operator norm gate.
Source meshes use their own frozen load sets; no coupled aeroelastic continuum limit is established.
plan.pre_full_study_extension: Require complete nodal tangent-step refinement and independent modal-shape agreement, in addition to the original fixed pilot gates. Report weakest/worst individual nodal load column explicitly.

root_refinement.scope: Single weak static z-force at s=12 mm, same frozen N32 loads, first interval only refined. No global or dynamic pointwise-convergence claim.

method.reference: Separate nonlinear continuum base and exact spatial tangent ODE with distributed real inertia. Twelve-state interval transfer matrices and a clamped/free multiple-shooting boundary solve retain all six nodal wrench inputs and outputs.
method.production: Complete retained central-difference mixed structural tangent and newly assembled all-nodal real-mass load transfer. Dynamic mobility solves the full mixed equations at lambda=0 and -5+i*[50,100,150,250] per second.
method.modes: Four lowest purely oscillatory native roots found below 200 Hz seed local independent determinant brackets. Each independent shape is recovered from the continuum end-wrench nullspace and matched with span-weighted physical translation/rotation MAC.
method.normalization: Motion is normalized by span for translations and by one radian for rotation; conjugate loads use the reciprocal motion scales and GJ/span energy scale. Whole-matrix Frobenius, six diagonal component blocks and worst individual load columns are reported separately.
method.root_refinement: Retain exactly the N32 equivalent loads and original nodes; subdivide only the first 12 mm interval into 1,2,4,8 cells, recompute the mixed equilibrium, and compare its static response to a z force at s=12 mm.

sources.scope: Distributed real-mass kinematics and inertial force/moment balance; no original discretization parity claimed.

retained_failures: run-01 terminated during JSON serialization of a NumPy boolean after four complete cases and the fifth arrays. The terminal record and original helper snapshots remain. run-02 only corrects scalar serialization; physical inputs and gates are unchanged.

Worst weak nodal load columns exceed whole-matrix bounds and are not promoted to pointwise validation. One persistent first-interval axial channel is separately resolved by local refinement; other weak dynamic channels still require refinement.
limits: Frozen equivalent nodal loads are reconstructed from saved resultants, not independently recomputed aerodynamics; each source mesh has its own load set.
Complex spectral shifts are evaluation points, not added damping. There is no material damping, fluid feedback or apparent mass in this isolation study.
Overall matrix-norm convergence does not bound every point-load channel. The finest worst individual column still differs by 34.23%.
Eight locally matched oscillatory modes do not classify the full continuum or aeroelastic spectrum and do not prove stability.
The reconstructed 22.58 versus published 24.58 m/s flutter discrepancy remains unresolved. No physical parameter was fitted.
